items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And one night, they called Henry Red Allen, you know, from Louisiana. He worked with Louis Armstrong for awhile. He worked with the Blue Rhythm Band for awhile. He got up to play. ... ctx.x: Anyway, I got hired with Monk. Monk -- I don't know of any adjectives or verbs to describe this person. He was the father of the be-bop era. Like they had changed all of the charts around like, simple tunes like "Dinah" and "Sweet Sue", they had augmented them and changed them around so that the ones that wanted to come up and jam wouldn't be so quick to jam when they found out there was a different set of changes, you know. And people like -- they would have a Monday night party there for whoever was appearing…
